question: U12: the font list, opened from Headings' Font row and from Fonts > Buttons' three, read with no pick. Where it sits, its heads, rows and controls.

note.text: Fewer fonts, faster site. Learn More

answer: A list under the row, 342 by 550 at the panel's right edge, not a view of its own. Under Headings' row (bottom 239) it opens at 239. Under the Buttons rows: 251 under the first, 412 under the second and third, which the panel has further down, so at window 1000 its top stops at 412, and 962 is its lowest bottom. Search all fonts, Filter by language or script, Upload and manage custom fonts, then heads In Use, Sans Serif, Serif, Mono, Other, Additional Fonts. 1 name in use, then 5, 3, 2, 1493, and none under Additional Fonts. In Use holds a check on the row and the words Fewer fonts, faster site. Learn More. Rows are 44 apart and drawn as pictures of the name in its own font. Save stayed off through opening, scrolling and Escape.
